generationTemplate: Create ONE standalone production furniture image for Ecovit 2D floor plans. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Subject: {subject}. Strict true orthographic TOP VIEW, camera exactly 90 degrees directly overhead. Intended footprint width {widthCm} cm, depth {depthCm} cm: silhouette width-to-height ratio approximately {widthCm}:{depthCm}. Use canvas orientation that best fits the object, tightly fit whole silhouette with narrow transparent margins. Refined colored architectural plan illustration matching reference: crisp thin warm-gray outlines, muted beige light oak ivory sage/leaf green stainless gray as appropriate, delicate interior material detail and tonal shading. All vegetation must be simplified with clustered shapes and low detail. Genuinely transparent alpha background. ONLY ONE OBJECT. No text, label, frame, floor, grid, pedestal, room, scenery, surrounding decoration or external shadow. No perspective/isometric projection, front elevation, visible vertical cabinet faces, logos or watermark. Keep all object parts within image, no clipping. Preserve the reference's realistic soft material finish, without exaggerated photorealism. New isolated asset, NOT a contact sheet or edit of the board.

treeEditPrompt: Edit this tree canopy asset for Ecovit architectural top-view floor plans. Keep the strictly overhead orthographic view, green/sage palette, general round irregular silhouette, true transparent background and thin discreet outline. No leaf veins, no individual leaves, no micro texture, no tiny scalloped edges, no external shadows or outlines in neon colors. Isolated tightly framed, transparent alpha canvas, no text, no ground, no other objects.
